u27fc2cd344: While programming the chip, the programmer calls the c_main function in the .authrun file
u82796a631a: When the programmer calls the callback function c_main, the values flash_id, seq, timestamp and uuid in the ops structure have already been filled in by the programmer
ud520b88b29: The callback function c_main is responsible for filling out_enc_data and returning out_len
ud6ddc0ade6: The programmer writes the content of out_enc_data, of length out_len, into the chip
u6ef95bd38d: The programmer's processing flow, in pseudocode, is as follows:
u1e0f7ebf25: // This code is implemented on the programmer side; algorithm companies do not need to care about it
ubc9712788c: // The algorithm company must implement the c_main function in the .authrun
u4a3f0cc488: // Call the c_main callback function of the .authrun
u9bf341c880: // After c_main is called, out_enc_data should have been filled and out_len (the length of the encrypted data to write to the chip) returned
u737c1f8894: // out_len generally cannot exceed 255; for some chip models with fewer resources, the actual limit is smaller. Actual testing prevails
